Pierre Gasly's 2023 teammate at Alpine was Esteban Ocon. The 2023 final standings list only two Alpine F1 Team drivers, Gasly (62 pts) and Ocon (58 pts), and the Monaco race report shows both finishing for Alpine. The standings don't show race-by-race entries, so I couldn't confirm from the data that Ocon started every round, but no other Alpine driver appears in the 2023 results I found.

ANSWER: Esteban Ocon
